I’m not able to pull live data, but here’s how you can find out which Indian Premier League (IPL) match is scheduled for today:

| What to look for | Where to check |
|------------------|----------------|
| **Match day & number** | Official IPL website (www.iplt20.com) → “Fixtures” tab |
| **Teams playing** | Same “Fixtures” page; each match lists the two squads |
| **Venue** | Listed next to the match details |
| **Kick‑off time** | Usually shown in IST (Indian Standard Time) |
| **Live stream / broadcast** | Check the “Live” section or your local sports broadcaster (e.g., Star Sports, SonyLIV, Hotstar) |

If you’re on a mobile device, the IPL app (available on iOS and Android) will also push notifications for upcoming matches and give you the exact start time.

**Quick tip:** If you’re looking for a specific team’s match today, just filter the fixtures by that team on the website or app. That will show you whether they’re playing, who the opponent is, and when the game starts.
